title: Emperor Palpatine
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: Emperor Palpatine has re-emerged to pull Luke to the dark side. But his body is old and he must transfer his consciousness to the young body of a clone, seen here (front) in a painting by Dave Dorman for issue #5 of Dark Horse Comics' DARK EMPIRE. Cam Kennedy shows Han Solo and Chewbacca's last-second escape from an Imperial hunter-killer droid (back).
